title: Derived tensor product of perfect objects is perfect
statement: Let (X,\mathcal O_X) be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let K,L be perfect objects [def-pc-perfect-complex] of D(\mathcal O_X) [def-pc-derived-category]. Then the derived tensor product K\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_X}L is a perfect object of D(\mathcal O_X).
